describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on four short limbs with its body held low to the ground. It has a stout, elongated trunk with a thick, fleshy tail extending to the left and a broad, flat head at the right end. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the base of the tail is covered in overlapping, rounded brown scales with darker edges, while the head, throat, belly, limbs, and tail are pale pink, wrinkled, and fleshy with a moist appearance. Behind the head on both sides are multiple feathery pink external gills. The head has large golden eyes with dark pupils, small nostrils, and a wide mouth. The overall form combines a low quadrupedal amphibian body with heavy dorsal armor.
